rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides IP geolocation services through integration with the IP2Location.io API, enabling AI agents to retrieve detailed location and network information for any IPv4 or IPv6 address. Built by IP2Location using Python with FastMCP and httpx, it offers a single comprehensive tool that returns geographic data (country, region, city, coordinates, timezone), network details (ASN, ISP, domain), mobile information (MCC, MNC, carrier), security insights (proxy detection, threat analysis), and additional metadata like currency, language, and weather information. The implementation supports both free tier usage (1,000 queries/day) and API key authentication for enhanced limits (50,000 queries/month), making it valuable for security analysis, fraud detection, content localization, network troubleshooting, and building location-aware applications without manual IP lookup processes.
